videos.caption: My AI app stack is a lot smaller than people expect. I don’t want 40 tools. I want a few tools that each earn their place. For thinking, writing, strategy, research, and complex work, I keep coming back to Claude and ChatGPT. Codex is becoming a bigger part of how I handle technical work and build faster. For creation, Canva is still one of the easiest ways to turn an idea into something useful. Descript and CapCut handle a lot of the video work. Midjourney is still useful when I want more stylized visuals. For organization, I keep things simple. Google Drive, Slack, and a small number of tools I already use every day. For automation, Zapier and Make are still two of the first places I look when I see repetitive work. The bigger lesson is this: your AI stack does not need to be huge. Pick the tool you think best with. Pick the tool you create with. Pick the tool where your work lives. Pick the tool that handles repetitive work. Then get good at connecting them. That is where the real leverage starts. Which app on this list do you use the most? #AItools #ClaudeAI #ChatGPT #AIToolsForBusiness #ArtificialIntelligence
